items.title: Why SaaS Will Not Die in the AI Era | Ft. Atlassian CTO

items.title: 🔴 LIVE: Tech Mahindra Q2 Profits Rise 32.7% as Wipro Deal Bookings Slump | Front Page
items.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a strong quarterly performance with net profit jumping 32.7% year-on-year to ₹1,250 crore, driven by robust deal wins and operational efficiencies under its ongoing turn-around strategy. In contrast, competitor Wipro saw its large-deal bookings decline alongside a continuous drop in total headcount, highlighting stark divergence among India's IT services giants as enterprise clients reallocate budgets toward AI implementation. Globally, Gartner warned that $3.5 trillion in global AI data-center investments face overcapacity risks, Anthropic reported $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, and Tesla unveiled its long-awaited flying Roadster prototype.
